decisions.text: Optional seam additions only: Modifier.activeRound?: number; GameState.endedTurns?: PlayerId[]; GameState.pendingFloodPlayers?: PlayerId[]; GameState.pendingDraws?: PlayerId[]. These record exact event windows, completed turns and suspended event/replacement draws.

A dying or eaten detritivore releases unfinished processing; the dead card stays available for reassignment. Attached cards leave play with their decomposed host and go to their owners' discard piles; only the host's stored pool is returned.

Playing a microbe or detritivore with a target uses the play AP charge and resolves decomposition or assignment as part of that play; using an already-played card uses its respective action AP cost. A duplicate copy of the same adaptation cannot be attached to the same organism.

AP and eating limits reset before exposing a round-opening Flood choice so the resumed round is ready to play. Empty Flood fields expose choose(null), granting +1 P, rather than automatically choosing for a player.

Simultaneous nutrient-threshold winners produce a draw; a referee lowering pools below thresholds reopens play. An all-event edited deck deals a shorter opening hand and returns its events to the shuffled deck without looping.
